The cardinality of a finite set $A$ is the number of elements in $A.$ 

Notice that the elements of our set 

$$
-200,\,-193,\,-186,\,…
$$

form an arithmetic sequence with a common difference $d=7:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =7 \\  & =-193-(-200) \\  & =-186-(-193) \\  & =⋯\end{aligned}
$$

The $n$th term of our arithmetic sequence, denoted ${a}_{n},$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & =-200+(n-1)\cdot 7 \\  & =-200+7n-7 \\  & =7n-207.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can express $A$ in set-builder notation as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={7n-207:n\in N,\,1\le n\le N}\end{aligned}
$$

where $N\in N$ is to be determined.

To find $N,$ we solve the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}7N-207 & =997 \\ 7N & =1\,204 \\ N & =\frac{1\,204}{7} \\ N & =172\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our set $A$ can be expressed as

$$
A={7n-207:n\in N,\,1\le n\le 172}.
$$

Finally, since $A$ has $172$ elements, we must have $|A|=172.$
